E0407

`.drop()` reason missing or invalid (D-IGNORERET2)

What

`.drop()` reason missing or invalid (D-IGNORERET2)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0407

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0407: tests/ui/drop_method_empty_reason.stderr.

Error [E2417]: explicit failure domain ``E`` is not an Error type
  --> tests/ui/drop_method_empty_reason.jet:5:8
    |
  5 | fn f() Int !E -> Ok(1)
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: A `!` contract may name `Err`, a Core error, a type marked `#Error`, an all-error union, or `Never`; arbitrary value types do not describe failures.
 Fix: use a Core error, add `#Error` to a local error type, or remove the explicit error contract.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2417

Error [E2402]: `?` can't convert `E` into `Err` — no declared conversion exists
  --> tests/ui/drop_method_empty_reason.jet:7:12
    |
  7 | fn run() { f().drop("") }
    |            ^
 Why: `?` uses the declared conversion rail; `E` can reach `Err` only through `impl E -> Err`
 Fix: add `impl E -> Err { … }` before this function, or change the return type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2402

Error [E0407]: `.drop()` reason must not be empty
  --> tests/ui/drop_method_empty_reason.jet:7:16
    |
  7 | fn run() { f().drop("") }
    |                ^^^^
 Why: the reason documents why this result is intentionally discarded
 Fix: write `.drop("why this is fine to ignore")` with a real explanation
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0407
